data.name: Afiyah
data.gender_notes: Afiyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Afiyah is an Arabic name that means 'healthy' or 'well-being'. It is also associated with the concept of spiritual well-being. The name Afiyah carries the meaning “Healthy” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Afiyah usually hope their child will grow to embody healthy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Purification of the soul and body
data.etymology: Afiyah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Healthy.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Afiyah total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

It is also a popular name in some other parts of the world with a significant Muslim population, such as Indonesia and Malaysia. In many Muslim communities, the name Afiyah is considered a desirable one, as it signifies strength, vitality, and a strong foundation for a good life.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Afiyah holds deeper significance beyond just physical health. In Islamic theology, health and well-being are not only physical but also include spiritual and emotional balance. Therefore, the name Afiyah can be seen as a reminder to strive for a healthy and balanced life in all three aspects. It is a name that encourages one to seek inner peace, spiritual growth, and a strong connection with Allah (God). In this way, Afiyah is not just a name, but a constant reminder of the importance of maintaining a balanced and healthy life in all aspects.
